newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico mint sells new silver savings coins.
newsitem.headline: Mexico mint sells new silver savings coins.

text.p: Mexico started selling from Tuesday additional silver savings coins and has redesigned other traditional coins in a new drive to boost savings in the metal, authorities said.

Mexico is the world's largest refined silver producer and has a long history in savings coins minted from the precious metal. The coins, known as Libertad, have no formal street value and prices vary on world silver prices.
The central bank said it is offering for sale two ounce and five ounce silver coins and had redesigned the coins to make them more attractive.
The new savings coins are in addition to the one ounce, half ounce, quarter ounce, tenth ounce and twentieth ounce coins already minted.
